_comment: Video counts of every Auto FLOWER pick with match video (Belding USMIBEQ, Fruitport USMIFRQ2), keyed "<EVENT> <MATCH> <TEAM> <pick#>". Counted on video by four independent reviewer sessions on 22 Nov 2026 that were not shown the log counts, then reconciled against the log (notes after "Reconciled:"). clip times are seconds into that match's video.mp4 from tools/match-review; play_at is the Auto PLAY used. Read by tools/flower-picks/flower_picks.py report.

USMIBEQ M-10 19429 1.note: Light sync (PLAY 4 s after the qualifier offset, as playoffs run); same footage as 20245's M-10. Blue AUDIENCE FLOWER is behind its own near-wall reflection and our robot during the pick; pieces on it before (8 s) and possibly one at its base after (15.5 s), so in_seen and left_on_flower cannot be told. Volley 14.7-19.4 s: 3 balls tracked rising from our robot at ~17.2, ~18.7 and ~19.15 s, each into the blue CELL area; none 14.7-17.1 s, none after 19.5 s (robot drives off ~19.9 s). The upper CELL is washed out by glare, so a 4th ball close behind another cannot be ruled out. carried 0 assumes the preload volley (log 6.8-8.3 s, not counted on video here) emptied it.
USMIBEQ M-10 19429 1.clip: pick: video.mp4 at 60.5 s; volley: video.mp4 at 67.5 s

USMIBEQ M-10 20245 1.note: Red SCORING FLOWER beside our start, far side near the red HIVE: 4 POLLEN in it (3 in the posts + 1 at the base) from -1 to 9.5 s; our robot faces into it 10.0-14.5 s (intake hidden behind the robot) and it is empty at 15.5 s, no piece seen on the floor around it. So the FLOWER lost 4 to our robot (count from the FLOWER, not from pieces seen entering). Volley 15.2-19.4: small and far; balls seen rising from the robot at ~17.3, ~18.6, ~19.0 s, and maybe one more around 17.6-17.8 s (lost against the CELL), so 3-4 out. Carried unknown: preload volley not counted on video. Sync is doubtful: the light went off at 0.0 but showed red again at ~1.0 s before turning green (the helper's green measured 1.33-2.33 s against the log's 0.92), and the robot sat at the FLOWER from ~5 s, before the log's PickFlower card, so times may be ~1 s off.
USMIBEQ M-10 20245 1.clip: pick: video.mp4 at 58.0 s (4 in FLOWER) to 64.0 s (empty); volley: video.mp4 at 65.7-67.6 s

USMIBEQ M-3 20245 1.note: CAN'T TELL. The red SCORING FLOWER pick (9.9-13.8 s) happens behind both HIVEs, robot seen only from behind and blurred by a camera pan at 10 s; no FLOWER visible. Volley 15.0-18.9: robot shoots away from the camera; balls are seen only landing in the far red CELL, which went from ~4 pieces at 15.0 s to ~8 in its row by 18.5 s (arrivals ~16.3-18.0 s), so roughly 4 landed, but individual balls cannot be told apart from bounces, misses are not visible, and the partner (10104) may also have scored there. Preload volley ~6.9-7.9 s not counted. If all 4 landed from us and nothing was carried, the pick would be 4, but this is not a count. | Reconciled: pick hidden behind the HIVEs; the log: 1 carried, the next volley 5 dips (dips run high by up to 1) and 2 counted, lane 1->4; the far red CELL gained about 4. Log-based 4.
USMIBEQ M-3 20245 1.clip: pick: video.mp4 at 57.0-60.8 s (hidden); volley: video.mp4 at 63.2-65.0 s
